files.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create original production-ready portrait 9:20 environment art for a polished gothic action RPG for phones. True hand-pixeled game art with crisp ordered clusters and moody directional lighting. The viewer looks down into an underground cathedral furnace chamber from near its interior, in three-quarter top-down perspective. Composition fills the screen edge-to-edge. The top third is dramatic dense architecture: deep ribbed gothic crypt doorway haloed by old smoke and dusty direction light, heavy blackened masonry, two deliberately asymmetric sacrificial lanterns glowing burnt orange at the shoulders, shadowed bone niches. The middle from y=32 to y=67 percent is the compact legible, empty walkable arena, a broken chalk-pale inlaid slate emblem at center with low contrast dark gray worn flagstones, soot patterns, narrow light grazing edge details and visible step depth. Mostly keep it flat and clear across the usable width, with only dark distressed piers at extreme edges. From y=70 percent are wide shallow stairs down, carved foreground railings and heavy dark iron buttresses at the left and right edges, some intermittent tiny cropped torchlight. Bottom 14 percent is restful near-black stone floor with edge textures. The scene should feel like the camera moved physically into the room, emphasizing a short distance between the actors and architecture instead of a huge flat carpet. Restrained charcoal, cool silver smoke, dry rust, oxidized brass and dim amber. Keep human readability strong around the central fighting stage. Rich painterly ambience expressed in precise readable square pixel clusters, akin to detailed hand-pixeled 16-bit JRPG environment sprites. No live characters, monsters, scene text, letters, HUD, items, watermarks, horizontal framing graphics, collage or interface elements.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original separate 9:20 portrait environment background for the hero selection scene of a polished dark gothic 2D pixel-art mobile action RPG. One monumental vaulted crypt niche seen near straight on with a slight top-down tilt: a deep arched central alcove with an empty nearly black distressed wall and a narrow teal-silver beam of moonlight leaking from above, broad stone plinth at y=70%, twin heavily shadowed ribs and carved fan vault. Left and right at the margins, cracked stone statues, a hint of hanging strips of oxidized deep burgundy fabric and a few practical low amber flames lighting the edges. Reserve an uncluttered central pocket from y=27 to y=69 for a tall sprite in front of it. The upper area y=6 to y=18 should be dark and clean for an overlaid title, lower fifth has shaded stone and heavy shadow for overlaid buttons. Dramatic depth and restrained light, ash grey, bone, blackened bronze, wine red. Texture at the edges, subtle specular clusters on stone, complete environment painted in detailed original sharp 16-bit retro video game pixel art. No characters or monsters, no text or marks that resemble writing, no logo, no UI or overlays. Edge-to-edge art transformed vertically to make one central character feel monumental.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL game-ready image atlas of exactly twelve unique gothic fantasy action spell icons for a premium action RPG touchscreen, FOUR COLUMNS × THREE ROWS on a 4:3 landscape canvas. Each square cell equal size with centers exactly at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=16.67%,50%,83.33%. Each motif centered, silhouette takes roughly 60-68% of its own cell, no element crosses a cell, leave generous invisible gutters. Blackened charcoal backgrounds within each square, tactile engraved realistic steel and carved bone highlights, one prominent readable silhouette or gesture per icon, sharply crafted antique-medieval ink and rich tightly controlled emissive accents. Each should still be legible at 32px. Row 1 left to right: gleaming silver diagonal sword on dark crimson, curling intersecting crescent slashes in vivid amber gold, a straight burning slash cleaving a cracked black tile in ember orange, a boot heel and two trailing silver motion streaks showing a backward dodge in antique ivory. Row 2 left to right: a single diagonal arrowhead and shaft in warm silver, fan of three arrowheads in olive green, one heavy antique gold piercing arrow through an iron ring, a dark arched gateway with a tiny warm opening in ember light. Row 3 left to right: a violet crystal bolt with a sharp pale lilac tip, an open purple circle rune with brighter four neutral geometric light fragments, white ice crystal burst in glacial blue, two bronze parallel pause bars in a dim recess. The cells are textures that sit inside the game's own frames, so no drawn tile borders, no text, no words, no grid lines, no watermarks, no numbers, no existing game icons, no copied IP. Visual family stays cohesive in detail and scale with restrained near-black empty gutters.
